D'Angelo Russell led the Timberwolves with 30 points (11-13 FG, 4-5 3PT), 2 rebounds and 12 assists.
CLE won 3 of 4 factors: ball security, second chances, getting to the line. Effective FG% 54.5 to 63.4.
Biggest swing: Taurean Prince offensive rebound (Q4 13.3), −18 points of CLE win probability.

Bench points: CLE 27, MIN 36. Points in the paint: 42–54. Second-chance points: 22–6.
